senses.gloss:
Hide,Ⓒs.Ⓓcarman n., ajinaM, dftiH, kftti f., paSu-carman n. -tvac f.; ‘h(ide)-bound’ dfQamuzwi, kfpaRa; avaSya, avinaya, kaWora, kaWina.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹpracCad 10, guh 1 U, gup 1 P, aMtarDA 3 U, tiroDA, sTag 10, apavf c.; See Conceal.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓguh-gup pass., gupta-nilIna a. BU 1 P, ni-lI 4 A, tiroBU, tiroDA pass.; ‘h(ide)s behind the bushes’ viwa-pAMtaritastizWati-Bavati.
ⓃHid, Hidden,Ⓒa.ⒹgUQa, gupta, pracCanna, CAdita, aMtarhita, tirohita, aMtarita, apavArita, niBfta, sTagita, lIna, nilIna.
Ⓝ[Hid]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹgopanaM, gupti f., pracCAdanaM, sTaganaM, tiroDAnaM; ‘h(iding)-place’ niBfta-gUQa-sTAnaM, guptiH, niBftaM.

Hideous,Ⓒa.ⒹbIBatsa, vikfta, Gora, BIzaRa, karAla, ugradarSana, karAla-muKa-vadana, kadA-kAra, BIma-Gora-darSana-Akfti, ugra-Gora-rUpa, durdarSana; ‘Oh! this is indeed a h(ideous) spectacle’ haMta bIBatsamevAgrato vartate (Mal. 5).
Ⓝ[Hideous]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹugraM, GorarUpeRa, bIBatsaM.
Ⓝ[Hideous]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹGoratA, karAlatA, ugratA.
